premise.oneLiner: A wholesome, high-retention third-person Minecraft SMP mystery told like an emotional urban legend: strange server behavior -> public mislabeling/bullying -> cruel breaking point -> real-world human truth -> Owner/community Minecraft-engineered redemption -> story-tied CTA.
mustHave: An immediate weird server statistic, timestamp, or rule violation in seconds 0-5 proven with crisp 3D server props/UI (chat toast, scoreboard, chest book, floating badge)
An open-loop reversal promise by 0:07-0:11 ('when they found out why...') so viewers stay past the dip
Cross-cut from the Minecraft SMP server into grounded 3D real-world sets (hospital shift, bedroom PC desk, classroom) revealing the human reason behind the player's behavior
An antagonistic mistake or cruel moment on the server that creates emotional heartbreak (sad Up theme)

Owner / server community stepping in using genuine clever Minecraft mechanics (sculk sensors, redstone lamps, signed books, campfire beacons) for a visible tear-jerking payoff (happy Up theme, started cleanly at 0:02+)
Our framework's full 3D visual quality: shaders, rich multi-part props, kinetic inOutSine camera moves, and full-body locomotion — NEVER static slideshow shots or 1-inch actor slides
never: Clone or 1:1 copy the 3 AM Mom or Deaf Eli reference stories: model their 7-beat structure and emotional retention engine for original SMP scenarios
Leave shots static, zoomed out (> 11m at Frame 0), or separated by blank background stone walls without depth/props
Skip the happy/sad dual-track Up score dynamics or leave raw un-trimmed 0:00-0:01 silence in Happy Up

reference.note: Studied two 50k+ Shorts from the owner's reference channel: 87.9s runtime, 36-48 cuts (~1.6-1.9s median shot), 7-beat SMP-to-IRL-to-redemption spine, server chat + nametag storytelling, and Up happy/sad theme switching.

camera.note: Combine the 50k references' fast 1.5-1.9s visual cut rhythm and 3D SMP storytelling HUD props with our engine's smooth inOutSine camera choreography (cam.push, cam.orbit, cam.crane, cam.truck, cam.ots), shaders, and >= 0.65m travel / >= 22 deg orbits.

film.shortsRule: Target 65-110s (~220-290 words) matching the two 87.9s 50k reference Shorts. Never exceed 2:58.

music.note: Two-track Up score mastered cleanly (~110% louder presence, Happy pre-trimmed past the silent 0:00-0:01 intro straight to 0:02.000). Switch tracks per scene via music.sections[].track between up_happy.m4a (hook/SMP discovery/Owner rally/payoff/CTA) and up_sad.m4a (IRL struggle/cruel breaking point).
